name: New Hampshire
overview: Income-tested relief refunds part of the State Education Property Tax to qualifying homeowners; local exemptions are separate.

programs.name: Low and Moderate Income Homeowners Property Tax Relief
programs.incomeDefinition: Adjusted gross income under DP-8 rules; use the claim-year instructions.
programs.incomeLimits: $37,000 single; $47,000 married or head of New Hampshire household.
programs.maximumBenefit: Income-tiered relief on qualifying homestead value, capped at $220,000 of value.
programs.formulaSummary: Refund qualifying State Education Property Tax using eligible homestead value and income-tier factors; this is not a refund of the whole local property-tax bill.
programs.application: Form DP-8 or Granite Tax Connect, May 1–June 30 following the property-tax year.
eligibilityNotes: Own a qualifying homestead and reside there April 1 of the claim year.
programs.programYear: 2025 property-tax relief uses April 1, 2025 residence; applications May–June 2026.

researchNotes: The 2025 application window covered 2024 property taxes; 2025-property-tax claims follow in 2026. The listed program covers homeowner relief.
